summary: Verified font-size dropdown fix (bug reported by user) on desktop /gestalten AND admin template editor /verwaltung/artikel/holzscheibe/vorlagen/neu with rapid 12->48->20 within 300ms, type-then-pick, and 10x randomized flakiness runs. Backend image_shape validation (rect/circle/ellipse/heart accepted; triangle/oval/empty/square/RECT rejected) and existing P0 masks suite pass. Mobile MobileStudio renders at 390x844 with no horizontal overflow and expected ms-* bottom bar tiles.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: TextProperties now uses refs (latest/updateRef/valuesRef) + functional commit, so rapid dropdown picks and interleaved typing+dropdown resolve to the last chosen value in both canvas data-elements and the text-font-size input.
PASS: FontSizeControl choose() path commits value synchronously via onChange and clamps display text, preserving numeric parity with element font_size.
PASS: StudioPage.updateElement uses commit(current=>...) functional form so concurrent debounced updates do not revert state.
PASS: Draft Element model enforces image_shape literal rect/circle/ellipse/heart; invalid values (incl. uppercase/empty) 422 at API boundary.

NOTE: Did not re-run full iteration24 customer flow (not required per request). Mobile iterations covered only a smoke of layout/overflow and bottom bar presence; deeper interactive mobile touch/gesture scenarios (pinch zoom, snap-to-centre during drag, Zuschneiden crop pixel comparison) were not executed in this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the targeted font-size regression (10/10 desktop /gestalten + 10/10 admin editor + rapid + type-then-pick); mobile smoke OK.

Image_shape backend tests exist in /app/backend/tests/test_studio_iteration25_image_shape.py.
rca of the issue: User bug 'Textgrößenänderung wird manchmal nicht angewendet' originated from stale closures in TextProperties.edit (captured old values/update between renders) and non-functional setState in StudioPage.updateElement, causing a debounced write with old base to overwrite the just-chosen font_size. Fix now uses valuesRef/latestRef/updateRef and functional commit; FontSizeControl's choose() calls onChange synchronously, so rapid picks always commit the last chosen size. Verified across 20 scripted flakiness rounds + rapid chain + typing/dropdown interleave on both desktop studio and admin template editor; input and canvas font_size matched the final chosen value every time.
